notes: Leather sandal soles among bones in Loculi 1105 and 1106 of the southern burial chamber of the eastern burial complex (Zelinger and Barbe). The burial complex is coded as the finds' context (choice C2); same feature as ATQ89-049. The text says the burial complex was not excavated (finds collected), so it is coded 'excavated (salvage)' at report level only.
